title: ArchitectureModel
description: Agent 1 (Solution Architect) output. A logical architecture topology grounded in project RFP evidence. Contains NO coordinates or PPT-specific details - layout is Agent 2's responsibility.

architectureType.description: Legacy enum values (BUSINESS/APPLICATION/DEPLOYMENT) or a canonical semantic rule-pack id (e.g. 'deployment.multi_az', 'data.data_flow').

rendererHints.description: Optional, non-geometric layout INTENT carried from Agent 1's semantic rule pack to Agent 2 (renderer_hints). Agent 1 MUST NOT place coordinates/sizes here - only strategy intent. Added additively in schemaVersion 1.0; absence is valid for backward compatibility. All fields are advisory; Agent 2's policy resolver/planner interprets them and reports unsupported values in diagnostics (never silently).

preferredLayout.description: Preferred layout strategy id from the rule pack's renderer_hints.preferred_layout, e.g. 'multi_az_columns', 'layered_architecture'. Agent 2's policy resolver maps this to an engine; an unsupported value is reported in diagnostics and falls back to a documented default (never silently).

alternateLayout.description: Optional secondary strategy id from renderer_hints.alternate_layout; used by Agent 2 as a preferred fallback before the generic default.

laneOrder.description: Ordered lane/stage ids for flow/swimlane strategies (renderer_hints.lane_order), e.g. ['sources','ingestion','processing','storage','consumption']. Advisory ordering only - no coordinates.

layerOrder.description: Ordered tier ids for layered strategies (renderer_hints.layer_order), e.g. ['channels','edge','integration','application_services','data'].

columns.description: Ordered column ids for comparison strategies (renderer_hints.columns), e.g. ['current','transition','target'].

emphasis.description: Aspects the layout should emphasize (renderer_hints.emphasize), e.g. ['network_boundaries','trust_boundaries','ingress','egress']. Advisory styling/grouping intent.

id.description: Stable, unique node identifier used across correction cycles.

type.description: Semantic node type. For DEPLOYMENT: CONTAINER, COMPUTE, NETWORK, STORAGE, DATABASE, INTEGRATION, EDGE, SECURITY, OBSERVABILITY, EXTERNAL. For BUSINESS/APPLICATION: corresponding semantic types.

parentId.description: ID of the containing node (e.g. a VPC or subnet), or null for top-level.

awsService.description: AWS service name when applicable, e.g. 'Amazon ECS'.

evidenceIds.description: IDs of retrieved evidence chunks that justify this node.

source.description: Must reference an existing node id.

target.description: Must reference an existing node id.
